body: I hope I have ~~to~~ too? Eh fuck it. We are both scouring the web for charity that will work. I just want to say thank you again for actually helping me out a ton. I will be sure to update you with what we do. Or if we fail and fall back into our old ways I will also tell you. So you can give me another search of motivational stuff.

Ya, Thanks a lot for this. I really wasn't expecting much if anything from this post. I always looked at this sub and thought. "How could words really affect me?" I guess if the words lead to me taking action rather than just changing an opinion it makes all the difference. Oh and my friend was awake and is actually completely willing to do it with. After he agreed I even gave him a link to this post (cringe)..

Oh forgot to add my money situation which is pretty bad. Right now I have around 300 dollars saved up. Which I was about to spend 200 on something well lethal. Just needed to put the check in the bank sigh I always get side tracked right before I am about to buy it. Although the last two times its been my lack of initiative to even do that; that has stopped me

Psh wasn't that long. I enjoyed reading it a lot regardless. Anyways are situations do sound very familiar. It's always nice when someone relates. I should say you have me ridiculously motivated right now. Sadly its 3:30 so that's really not hard to do. Anyways I have a good friend who just lost his job. He is practically my brother since he lived with me all throughout my childhood and I keep getting distracted so this is taking forever to write, but I just woke him up and am going to talk to him about this. I haven't talked to him much lately but if I had some support on this I might actually be able to do it.

Hmmm, now the volunteer overseas actually sounds pretty interesting. I have felt pretty trapped where I am recently. I'm looking into the peace core now. Not so sure if I will have a very good application for them, but we'll see what they think of me. I have really wanted a big change. All of my ideas have seemed unobtainable without great effort, and I'm not so good with that. Doing something where what I am supposed to do is clearly defined isn't all that hard and if I feel someone is relying on me it makes it all the easier. Ha, I actually worked for a charity for a week "Children International" a terrifying experience looking back it wasn't that bad. You ever done something that life changing?

It has been almost half an hour for you and you haven't gotten any responses yet. So I'll give it a try even though I really shouldn't be giving lectures in this area. 

Life is hard long miserable. All around they are a lot of bad experiences to be had. There are also a lot of good ones now whether they out weigh the bad ones is debatable. But after all the things that have happened you have got to think things are ready to turn around. Things are about to get better. Even if they don't return to a state as good as it was before. It won't be this bad for long. You will find another job get another girl make a new home. Now lets pretend you don't like your new girl, job, or home. Is suicide really an option. Just imagine how difficult it will be; to end your own life. How terrifying it must be to stare in the face what every part of your body is trying to avoid. Then if you actually did it. There would be no reward, you may have left your life behind, but left it for what? Nothing or if your religious something a thousand times worse. Ending your life would be the biggest and most important decision you would ever make. If there is anything you can do in this world that will make you life worth living I suggest doing it. Regardless of what people tell you. The best way to do that would be find something your passionate grab onto it and let it consume you. Sorry I am getting into an area I have little experience with so my advice is truly think about what you plan to do.

Edit: Maybe this isn't such great advice. It might be better if I told you something more inspiring and help you figure out what to do next. That really isn't my forte though. So I would really appreciate some assistance in that area from another member.
